description: Prepares creating a fund from a published template (Phase 6 factory by default). Give templateId, or list the assets wanted and it matches a template, or tells you honestly that none can hold them. Returns the unsigned createFund transaction, what the manager must mint next, and a signing link.

assets.description: Asset symbols the fund should hold, used to match a template.

entryFeeBps.description: Manager entry fee in basis points, 0 to 500. Default 0.

from.description: The wallet address that will sign (0x...). Never a private key. Omit it when a walletToken is passed — the wallet is resolved from the token instead.

imageUri.description: https:// or ipfs:// image for the fund.

minSkinBps.description: Manager skin requirement in basis points. 0 means the 5% default.

mintPriceEth.description: Price per share in ETH, a decimal such as 0.01.

raiseDurationDays.description: Raise length in days, 1 to 30. Default 7.

ref.description: Attribution tag for traffic measurement. Default "grok".

returnUrl.description: Optional https:// link back to your agent flow. The signing page shows it as a button after the transaction confirms, with ?tx=<hash>&status=confirmed added. Anything that is not an https:// URL is ignored.

walletToken.description: A wallet token from /sign?connect=1: connect once, store the token, and pass it instead of from on every prepare call. The wallet is resolved from the token (signature-checked, 90-day expiry). When both are passed they must name the same wallet.

name: polypad_prepare_fund_create
title: Prepare a fund launch
